# Gameplay source metadata test doubles

`tests/gameplay_rules_source_fixture.py` contains original project-authored local
transport fixtures. Official-style Wizards URLs identify the domain policy being
tested; no network request retrieves those pages during these tests. The invented
2032 dates, releases, metadata, body hashes and claims are synthetic inputs only.
They are not official Wizards facts, source-policy clearance, an actual rules
corpus, or execution authority.

These tests retain metadata contracts and bounded fictional bodies only. There is
no real Comprehensive Rules text or provider Card content in this fixture family.
